FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sweet Bliss Desserts, we specialize in creating and serving a wide variety of delectable desserts, including cakes, pastries, and ice cream. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products in a clean and inviting environment, ensuring customer satisfaction and safety. We prioritize food safety with a robust food safety program and maintain all necessary health department permits, passing inspections without citations. Our experienced team is dedicated to delivering exceptional service, and we routinely conduct staff training to enhance food handling and customer service skills. Additionally, we offer a selection of beverages to complement our desserts, with all staff trained in responsible service. We continuously strive to improve our operations through diligent equipment maintenance and adherence to industry best practices, fostering a safe and enjoyable experience for all our guests.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a small fire occurred in the kitchen due to a malfunctioning oven, resulting in minor smoke damage and repairs costing $1,200. The fire department responded and confirmed there were no injuries. The repairs have been completed and the kitchen has passed reinspection.
